newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish 10-year spread over Bunds sets record low.
newsitem.headline: Spanish 10-year spread over Bunds sets record low.

text.p: The Spanish 10-year bond spread over equivalent German Bunds set a record low at 93 basis points just before the close on Friday, dealers said.
The previous record, set on January 3, was 98 bps.
After a rollercoaster ride the Spanish debt market was ending the day very strong, pushed up by buying interest from foreign investors, dealers said.
The peseta jumped to 83.46/3.49 to the mark from 84.09/11 at yesterday's close. It hit levels not seen since May after soaring through the key 84.00 per mark level earlier in the session.
Traders said a lack of Bank of Spain intervention had allowed the Spanish currency to appreciate past the 84.00 level.
The central bank is thought to have been selling pesetas heavily against the mark to support this level since Wednesday.
